study.name: Melanoma (MSK, Clin Cancer Res 2021)
study.citation: Alexander N et al. Clin Cancer Res 2021

nf1_that_is_head.label: NF1-class melanomas that arose on the head

nf1_that_is_trunk.label: NF1-class melanomas that arose on the trunk

v600e_that_is_head.label: BRAF V600E melanomas that arose on the head

head_that_is_v600e.label: Head melanomas that are BRAF V600E

concordance.note: A referral cohort of cutaneous melanoma and melanoma of unknown primary, sequenced mostly from metastases; the unknown-primary column is those 140 patients. The study records the site as Head, Trunk, Upper Extremity, Lower Extremity or Unknown, and its paper's Table 1 calls the head column face. One patient has no site recorded.

cohort.name: MSK-IMPACT 50K Clinical Sequencing Cohort (MSK, Cancer Cell 2026)
cohort.filter: ONCOTREE_CODE = SKCM or MEL or DESM or SKLMM or SPZM; each patient counted once, by the first of their melanoma samples

path-skin.cohort_note: Melanomas filed as cutaneous, desmoplastic, lentigo maligna or Spitzoid melanoma, or as melanoma with no subtype recorded, which OncoTree files under skin (SKCM, DESM, SKLMM, SPZM, MEL) in the MSK-IMPACT 50K cohort (Cancer Cell 2026), tumours sequenced on targeted panels at one referral centre. A patient with melanoma samples under two pathways is counted once, on the pathway of their first sample.
